source: Tagalog (tl) and Cebuano (bis) renderings of every MATATAG Science Content-column title in the two competency files, keyed by the English title verbatim. Constraints: <=6 words, no colons, classroom loanwords kept where DepEd modules keep them, DOMAIN_NAMES vocabulary (packages/shared/src/curriculum) reused. `review: true` = the Tagalog is still uncertain (a coined or re-phrased title, or an open spelling choice) and the Cebuano awaits native review; `review: "bis"` = the Tagalog was verified (2026-09 pass) and only the Cebuano still awaits native review. `note` = why a loanword was kept over a Filipino/Cebuano form. Register for that call is DepEd's own Filipino science modules: an adapted DepEd form (friksyon, potosintesis) is preferred where one is standard; the English term stays where DepEd keeps it or where the Filipino gloss is ambiguous or inaccurate. ALL Cebuano entries await native-speaker review.

Plate Tectonics.note: Loanword kept: DepEd's Filipino-medium AP modules write Teorya ng Plate Tectonics; Tektonikang Plato is a Wikipedia coinage (11 hits vs 71 plate tectonics / 281 tectonic plate in the Tagalog corpus) and the fact bank says plate tectonics / plato.

Global interactions.note: Maps only to G10-E-10 (El Niño/ENSO and other global climatic phenomena acting on weather systems), so the title is anchored on klima; a bare Mga Pandaigdigang Ugnayan reads as geopolitical 'global relations'.

Global and local Sustainability.note: Sustainability kept: DepEd AP/Science Filipino materials use sustainability/sustainable untranslated; pagpapanatili on its own only means 'maintaining'.

Projectile motion.note: projectile kept: no Filipino/Cebuano science form (proyektil is unattested); the fact bank says projectile in all three languages.

Large-scale generation and distribution.note: pagbuo (Tagalog corpus 169) over paglikha (62): 'creating' electricity is the wording physics teachers avoid; Malawakang restores 'large-scale' (power plants and the grid, not any generation).

Homeostasis.note: homeostasis has no Filipino/Cebuano form; the fact bank uses it in all three languages.

Biotechnology.note: bioteknolohiya (Tagalog corpus 92) over biyoteknolohiya (3); the fact bank still says biotechnology, and this file's older row Levels of biological organization uses the biyo- spelling — a reviewer should pick one.
